prior_summary: A trainable two-frame causal encoder conditions TCP-residual diffusion and shares gradients with a four-class geometric phase head, targeting mid-skill entries and release-versus-acquisition ambiguity.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when TCP or Panda posture differs from home, invocation occurs in a supervised intermediate phase, or red is already near the buffer and handoff timing is uncertain.
termination_guidance: Require observed red stability at buffer and open/clear gripper for core handoff; do not treat the auxiliary phase prediction as grasp, release or successor-readiness proof.
limitations: The residual action is not invariant to target displacement. Phase labels are coarse geometry/finger supervision without contact truth and can be wrong after unseen misses. Large residuals and failures are unsupported.
